001package bank.reporting;
002
003import bank.model.Customer;
004import bank.model.Transaction;
005import bank.model.TransactionType;
006
007import java.math.BigDecimal;
008import java.time.LocalDateTime;
009import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.Collections;
012import java.util.List;
013
014/**
015 * ============================================================================
016 *  TransactionHistory.java
017 *  Owner: John (smartdude879@gmail.com)
018 * ============================================================================
019 *
020 *  ROLE:
021 *      Searches and filters a customer's transactions, then prints results.
022 *
023 *  SUPPORTED FILTERS (all optional — null means "no filter"):
024 *      - date range  (from / to, inclusive)
025 *      - account ID  (limit to one account)
026 *      - type        (DEPOSIT, WITHDRAW, FEE, INTEREST, ...)
027 *      - min / max amount
028 *      - description keyword (case-insensitive substring match)
029 *
030 *  Results are always in chronological order (oldest first).
031 *
032 *  USAGE:
033 *      TransactionHistory th = new TransactionHistory();
034 *      List&lt;Transaction&gt; results = th.search(customer, new SearchCriteria()
035 *          .type(TransactionType.WITHDRAW)
036 *          .minAmount(new BigDecimal("100.00")));
037 *      th.print(customer, criteria, results);
038 * ============================================================================
039 */
040public class TransactionHistory {
041
042    private static final int LINE_WIDTH = 70;
043    private static final String DIVIDER = "-".repeat(LINE_WIDTH);
044    private static final DateTimeFormatter DATE_FMT =
045            DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("MMM dd, yyyy HH:mm");
046
047    /**
048     * Applies the given criteria to the customer's transactions and returns
049     * the matching list in chronological order.
050     *
051     * Plain for-loop on purpose — easy to read line by line.
052     */
053    public List<Transaction> search(Customer customer, SearchCriteria criteria) {
054        List<Transaction> results = new ArrayList<>();
055
056        for (Transaction t : customer.getTransactions()) {
057            if (matches(t, criteria)) {
058                results.add(t);
059            }
060        }
061
062        // Sort oldest -> newest
063        Collections.sort(results, (a, b) -> a.getTimestamp().compareTo(b.getTimestamp()));
064        return results;
065    }
066
067    /**
068     * Returns true if this transaction passes every non-null criteria filter.
069     */
070    private boolean matches(Transaction t, SearchCriteria c) {
071        if (c.fromDate  != null && t.getTimestamp().isBefore(c.fromDate))  return false;
072        if (c.toDate    != null && t.getTimestamp().isAfter(c.toDate))     return false;
073        if (c.accountId != null && !t.getAccountId().equals(c.accountId))  return false;
074        if (c.type      != null && t.getType() != c.type)                  return false;
075        if (c.minAmount != null && t.getAmount().compareTo(c.minAmount) < 0) return false;
076        if (c.maxAmount != null && t.getAmount().compareTo(c.maxAmount) > 0) return false;
077
078        if (c.keyword != null) {
079            String description = t.getDescription() == null ? "" : t.getDescription();
080            if (!description.toLowerCase().contains(c.keyword.toLowerCase())) {
081                return false;
082            }
083        }
084        return true;
085    }
086
087    /** Convenience: search and print in one call. */
088    public void searchAndPrint(Customer customer, SearchCriteria criteria) {
089        print(customer, criteria, search(customer, criteria));
090    }
091
092    /**
093     * Prints a formatted list of transactions to the terminal.
094     */
095    public void print(Customer customer, SearchCriteria criteria, List<Transaction> txns) {
096        System.out.println();
097        System.out.println(DIVIDER);
098        System.out.println("  TRANSACTION HISTORY - " + customer.getName()
099                + " (" + customer.getId() + ")");
100
101        if (criteria.fromDate != null || criteria.toDate != null) {
102            System.out.printf("  Period  : %s  ->  %s%n",
103                    criteria.fromDate != null ? criteria.fromDate.format(DATE_FMT) : "start",
104                    criteria.toDate   != null ? criteria.toDate.format(DATE_FMT)   : "now");
105        }
106        if (criteria.accountId != null) System.out.println("  Account : " + criteria.accountId);
107        if (criteria.type      != null) System.out.println("  Type    : " + criteria.type);
108        if (criteria.minAmount != null) System.out.printf("  Min amt : $%,.2f%n", criteria.minAmount);
109        if (criteria.maxAmount != null) System.out.printf("  Max amt : $%,.2f%n", criteria.maxAmount);
110        if (criteria.keyword   != null) System.out.println("  Keyword : \"" + criteria.keyword + "\"");
111
112        System.out.println(DIVIDER);
113
114        if (txns.isEmpty()) {
115            System.out.println("  No transactions matched your criteria.");
116            System.out.println(DIVIDER);
117            System.out.println();
118            return;
119        }
120
121        System.out.printf("  %-4s  %-16s  %-12s  %-14s  %10s%n",
122                "#", "Date/Time", "Type", "Account", "Amount");
123        System.out.println("  " + ".".repeat(LINE_WIDTH - 2));
124
125        int i = 1;
126        for (Transaction t : txns) {
127            System.out.printf("  %-4d  %-16s  %-12s  %-14s  %10s%n",
128                    i++,
129                    t.getTimestamp().format(DATE_FMT),
130                    t.getType(),
131                    t.getAccountId(),
132                    String.format("$%,.2f", t.getAmount()));
133            if (t.getDescription() != null && !t.getDescription().isBlank()) {
134                System.out.printf("        Note: %s%n", t.getDescription());
135            }
136        }
137
138        System.out.println(DIVIDER);
139        System.out.printf("  %d transaction(s) found.%n", txns.size());
140        System.out.println(DIVIDER);
141        System.out.println();
142    }
143
144    // ── SearchCriteria builder ────────────────────────────────────────────────
145
146    /**
147     * Fluent builder for search filters. Any unset field means "no filter".
148     *
149     * Example:
150     * <pre>{@code
151     *   new SearchCriteria()
152     *       .from(LocalDateTime.of(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0))
153     *       .to(LocalDateTime.of(2026, 3, 31, 23, 59))
154     *       .type(TransactionType.DEPOSIT)
155     *       .minAmount(new BigDecimal("50.00"));
156     * }</pre>
157     */
158    public static class SearchCriteria {
159
160        LocalDateTime fromDate;
161        LocalDateTime toDate;
162        String accountId;
163        TransactionType type;
164        BigDecimal minAmount;
165        BigDecimal maxAmount;
166        String keyword;
167
168        public SearchCriteria from(LocalDateTime from)       { this.fromDate = from;   return this; }
169        public SearchCriteria to(LocalDateTime to)           { this.toDate   = to;     return this; }
170        public SearchCriteria account(String accountId)      { this.accountId = accountId; return this; }
171        public SearchCriteria type(TransactionType type)     { this.type = type;       return this; }
172        public SearchCriteria minAmount(BigDecimal min)      { this.minAmount = min;   return this; }
173        public SearchCriteria maxAmount(BigDecimal max)      { this.maxAmount = max;   return this; }
174        public SearchCriteria keyword(String keyword)        { this.keyword = keyword; return this; }
175    }
176}
